name: blau-memory-eval
description: A LongMemEval-style personal memory set (#70): about five months of a fictional user's conversations with Blau, knowledge-base notes, company documents, a YC practice collection, entities and validity-dated facts, with questions of five types (single-fact recall, temporal reasoning, knowledge updates, multi-hop through entities, abstention). The corpus extends #59's retrieval eval set (the same persona) with later sessions that update or contradict earlier ones.
consent: Synthetic. Written for Blau's evaluation; the user (Jordan Hale), the people and the companies are fictional.
